entities.name: Pedro Bantigue y Natividad
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Pedro Natividad Bantigue was a Filipino prelate of the Catholic Church. He is notably the first bishop in the Philippines to come from Hagonoy, as well as the Province of Bulacan.
